snippet.title: "Star Heritage: The Black Cobra" Official Trailer
snippet.description:
http://stepgames.ru/

The game takes place in Elite universe. For several centuries mankind lives under control of Arthangs— toadlike creatures invaded from the depth of space. On the Earth exists a resistance center. Their agents under the guise of merchants carried weapons to undefended planets. 

The main hero of the game is a secret agent of Earth, ejected to unknown planet and miraculously survived after his spaceship was destroyed. Communication with allies lost, so he has to rely only on himself to get out from the planet. Along the way Hero receives very valuable information, that allows to break Arthangs authority once and forever.

Features:
Beautiful landscapes
Pleasant music
Change of night and day
Interesting story
Interesting puzzles
Melee battles
